title: Laredo Voters Face Three Races on the December Ballot
excerpt: Laredo voters will decide three races in December: the District 8 special election on Dec. 5, and the mayoral runoff and Laredo College Board Position 9 runoff on Dec. 12, according to KGNS.
content:
Laredo voters have three races to keep track of in December, following the midterm elections, according to KGNS.

The first is the District 8 special election, set for Friday, Dec. 5. Early voting for that race runs from Nov. 23 through Dec. 1, according to KGNS. The article names no candidates for the District 8 race.

The second is the mayoral runoff, which voters will decide on Saturday, Dec. 12. Council member Alyssa Cigarroa faces Mayor Victor Treviño, according to KGNS.

The third is the Laredo College Board of Trustees Position 9 runoff, also decided on Dec. 12. Incumbent Tita Vela faces Eduardo Lopez, according to KGNS. Early voting for that race runs from Nov. 30 through Dec. 8.

KGNS did not publish early-voting times or polling locations for any of the three races in the article.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 16, 2026.
